attempts.text: MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.resolutionDate IS NULL AND n.resolutionName IS NULL) AND size(nodes(p))=size(apoc.coll.toSet([x IN nodes(p)|x.issueKey])) RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN relationships(p)|r.linkId] AS links

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.resolutionDate IS NULL AND n.resolutionName IS NULL) AND size(apoc.coll.toSet([x IN nodes(p)|x.issueKey]))=size(nodes(p)) RETURN 1

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.resolutionDate IS NULL AND n.resolutionName IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)<-[:DEPENDS]-(x:Issue) WHERE x.resolutionDate IS NULL AND x.resolutionName IS NULL AND NOT x IN nodes(p) } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[:DEPENDS]->(y:Issue) WHERE y.resolutionDate IS NULL AND y.resolutionName IS NULL AND NOT y IN nodes(p) } RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN relationships(p)|r.linkId] AS links

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.resolutionDate IS NULL AND n.resolutionName IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)<-[:DEPENDS]-(x:Issue) WHERE x.resolutionDate IS NULL AND x.resolutionName IS NULL AND NOT x IN nodes(p) } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[:DEPENDS]->(y:Issue) WHERE y.resolutionDate IS NULL AND y.resolutionName IS NULL AND NOT y IN nodes(p) } UNWIND nodes(p) AS n RETURN DISTINCT n.issueKey AS issue
